title: Bringing a gift to a holiday dinner
objectives: Thank the host and offer the gift
Offer to help with the meal

courseTemplate.setting: The guest brought Chinese tea. Dinner starts in ten minutes. The host will show guests where to sit.

roles.learner: A guest invited to a holiday dinner

courseTemplate.openingLine: Come in! It's so nice to see you.

targetPatterns.pattern: Thanks for having me. I brought you some Chinese tea.
targetPatterns.example: Thanks for having me. I brought you some Chinese tea.

targetPatterns.pattern: It's a small gift. Can I help with anything?
targetPatterns.example: It's a small gift. Can I help with anything?

targetPatterns.pattern: Thank you. Where should I sit?
targetPatterns.example: Thank you. Where should I sit?

targetPatterns.pattern: How do you usually celebrate Christmas?
targetPatterns.example: How do you usually celebrate Christmas?
targetPatterns.translation: 你们通常怎么过圣诞节？

targetPatterns.pattern: Do I need to bring anything to the dinner?
targetPatterns.example: Do I need to bring anything to the dinner?
targetPatterns.translation: 参加晚餐需要带东西吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: What's an appropriate gift for the host?
targetPatterns.example: What's an appropriate gift for the host?
targetPatterns.translation: 给主人带什么礼物合适？

targetPatterns.pattern: Happy Thanksgiving to you and your family!
targetPatterns.example: Happy Thanksgiving to you and your family!
targetPatterns.translation: 祝你和家人感恩节快乐！

targetPatterns.pattern: Is it okay if I don't drink?
targetPatterns.example: Is it okay if I don't drink?

targetPatterns.pattern: Could you tell me more about this tradition?
targetPatterns.example: Could you tell me more about this tradition?

targetPatterns.pattern: In China, we celebrate it a bit differently.
targetPatterns.example: In China, we celebrate it a bit differently.
targetPatterns.translation: 在中国我们的过法有点不一样。

stages.title: Thank the host and offer the gift
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Come in! It's so nice to see you.”
successCriteria: The learner can thank the host and offer the gift in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Thanks for having me. …”

stages.title: Offer to help with the meal
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “How thoughtful! You really didn't have to.”
successCriteria: The learner can offer to help with the meal in their own words.
hints: You can start with “It's a small gift. …”

stages.title: Ask where to sit politely
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Just make yourself at home. Dinner will be ready in ten minutes.”
successCriteria: The learner can ask where to sit politely in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Thank you. Where should …”
